Topics · Hard times

Can medicine explain everything about death?

No argument from gaps: a known scene, a question on sleep and death, a sentence that keeps a scientist humble.

Part 1 of 3

﴿فَلَوْلَآ إِذَا بَلَغَتِ ٱلْحُلْقُومَ٨٣ وَأَنتُمْ حِينَئِذٍ تَنظُرُونَ٨٤ وَنَحْنُ أَقْرَبُ إِلَيْهِ مِنكُمْ وَلَـٰكِن لَّا تُبْصِرُونَ٨٥ فَلَوْلَآ إِن كُنتُمْ غَيْرَ مَدِينِينَ٨٦ تَرْجِعُونَهَآ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ٨٧﴾

Translation of the meaning

Then why, when it [i.e., the soul at death] reaches the throat And you are at that time looking on - And We [i.e., Our angels] are nearer to him than you, but you do not see - Then why do you not, if you are not to be recompensed, Bring it back,[1620] if you should be truthful?

Translator's notes

[1620] i.e., return the soul to the body, meaning that just as you cannot prevent death when it is decreed, you will not escape the recompense when it is decreed.

Quran · Al-Waqi'ah 56:83-87

You have stood in the room this passage describes. The breath is leaving, the family is watching, and nothing anyone does reverses it. The passage says: when the soul reaches the throat and you look on, and We are nearer to him than you, though you do not see, then if you are not to be held to account, bring it back, if you are truthful. It does not argue. It points at the bedside you already know.

A question for you

What have you noticed in the room at the moment of death?

If you sayStillness.
ThenMany describe that stillness. The verses speak of One who is nearer in that moment, though unseen.
If you saySomething I cannot name.
ThenThat honesty is a good place to start. You need not name it now.
If you sayOnly what the monitors show.
ThenThat is an honest position too. The next passage looks at what you know from the other side of the bed: sleep.

Part 2 of 3

﴿ٱللَّهُ يَتَوَفَّى ٱلْأَنفُسَ حِينَ مَوْتِهَا وَٱلَّتِى لَمْ تَمُتْ فِى مَنَامِهَا ۖ فَيُمْسِكُ ٱلَّتِى قَضَىٰ عَلَيْهَا ٱلْمَوْتَ وَيُرْسِلُ ٱلْأُخْرَىٰٓ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ﴾

Translation of the meaning

Allāh takes the souls at the time of their death, and those that do not die [He takes] during their sleep. Then He keeps those for which He has decreed death and releases the others for a specified term. Indeed in that are signs for a people who give thought.

Quran · Az-Zumar 39:42

Translation

If he set his heart on himself, if he gathered to himself his spirit and his breath, all flesh would perish together, and man would turn again to dust.

Original · Hebrew

אִם־יָשִׂ֣ים אֵלָ֣יו לִבּ֑וֹ רוּח֥וֹ וְ֝נִשְׁמָת֗וֹ אֵלָ֥יו יֶאֱסֹֽף׃ יִגְוַ֣ע כָּל־בָּשָׂ֣ר יָ֑חַד וְ֝אָדָ֗ם עַל־עָפָ֥ר יָשֽׁוּב׃

Job · 34:14-15

World English Bible

The Quran sets death beside something every doctor knows: sleep. God takes the souls at death, and those that have not died, in their sleep. He keeps those for whom death is decreed and sends the others back until a set term. Each morning, a person returns who had gone from the controls. The passage explains neither. It asks you to reflect.

A question for you

Where is a person in deep sleep?

If you sayNowhere. The brain simply keeps running.
ThenThat describes the mechanism truly. The verse does not dispute it, and asks about the one who returns.
If you saySomewhere I cannot describe.
ThenThat is close to what the verse calls taking and sending back.
If you sayI do not know.
ThenThat is an honest answer, and the doorway to the next passage.

Part 3 of 3

﴿وَيَسْـَٔلُونَكَ عَنِ ٱلرُّوحِ ۖ قُلِ ٱلرُّوحُ مِنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّى وَمَآ أُوتِيتُم مِّنَ ٱلْعِلْمِ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا﴾

Translation of the meaning

And they ask you, [O Muḥammad], about the soul. Say, "The soul is of the affair [i.e., concern] of my Lord. And you [i.e., mankind] have not been given of knowledge except a little."

Quran · Al-Isra 17:85

Translation

But there is a spirit in man, and the Spirit of the Almighty gives them understanding.

Original · Hebrew

אָ֭כֵן רֽוּחַ־הִ֣יא בֶאֱנ֑וֹשׁ וְנִשְׁמַ֖ת שַׁדַּ֣י תְּבִינֵֽם׃

Job · 32:8

World English Bible

They ask you about the spirit. The reply is that the spirit is of my Lord's command, and that of knowledge you have been given only a little. This is a line an honest scientist can keep close. It does not say there is no knowledge to be had. It says the knowledge given is little, and what is asked about is not given in full. If medicine explains the mechanism of dying and leaves something behind, this is a sentence that agrees with you.

A question for you

Where does your knowledge of dying end?

If you sayAt the last heartbeat.
ThenBeyond that limit, the first passage speaks of the One who is nearer.
If you sayAt the last breath.
ThenAt that limit the instruments stop and the questions begin.
If you sayI do not think it ends cleanly.
ThenThat candour fits the verse: a small knowledge, honestly declared.

The same in the other books

Translation

I cry to Yahweh with my voice, and he answers me out of his holy hill. Selah. I laid myself down and slept. I awakened, for Yahweh sustains me.

ק֭וֹלִי אֶל־יְהוָ֣ה אֶקְרָ֑א וַיַּֽעֲנֵ֨נִי מֵהַ֖ר קָדְשׁ֣וֹ סֶֽלָה׃ אֲנִ֥י שָׁכַ֗בְתִּי וָֽאִ֫ישָׁ֥נָה הֱקִיצ֑וֹתִי כִּ֖י יְהוָ֣ה יִסְמְכֵֽנִי׃

the Psalms · 3:4-5

World English Bible

The Master said, 'Yu, shall I teach you what knowledge is? When you know a thing, to hold that you know it; and when you do not know a thing, to allow that you do not know it;-- this is knowledge.'

Chinese classics · Analects 2.17

Confucian Analects (Legge)

To know and yet (think) we do not know is the highest (attainment); not to know (and yet think) we do know is a disease.

Chinese classics · Tao Te Ching 71.1

Tao Teh King (Legge)

Be not proud because thou art learned; but discourse with the ignorant man, as with the sage. For no limit can be set to skill, neither is there any craftsman that possesseth full advantages. Fair speech is more rare than the emerald that is found by slave-maidens on the pebbles.

Ancient Egypt · Ptahhotep 1

Instruction of Ptah-hotep (Gunn, 1906)
